rejected_rule.statement: A defendant cannot raise high-flown technical objections designed to prolong the proceedings to defeat the purpose of the Act.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: In actions filed under this Act, defendants cannot raise high-flown technical objections designed to prolong the proceedings to defeat the purpose of the Act.
rejected_rule.statute_citation_verbatim: section 4(1) of the Debt Recovery (Special Provisions) Act No. 2 of 1990, as amended by Act No. 9 of 1994
